name: Fuse Hollister
bio: If it stands, it can fall.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-21/22 ("crew demolitions rigged", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Experimental until the owner looks it over. Name and bio are ours (the owner can rename it); "Crew Demolitions" until 2026-11-22, when the crew got its own names (owner, the lead's list). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner made it on their Meshy account (owner, 2026-11-22: "all the characters I added yesterday and today are my own Meshy creations"; recorded as Meshy Community CC0 until then). Left the Chrono Crew for Machines (owner, 2026-11-25). In Machines it bleeds oil and its bots take the robot names, as every Machine (a sealed armour suit).
